name: Conception
body:
School transmutation; Level cleric 3, hedge witch 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (three damiana leaves, steeped in a cup of hot water and drank by you)

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration until activated, up to 1 month

DESCRIPTION

With the casting of this spell, you guarantee that on your next attempt, you and your partner will conceive a child. Conception overcomes sterility or infertility in either you or your partner, whether natural or due to an injury, illness, or curse, as well as herbal remedies that normally block conception. Alchemical or magical means of blocking conception, such as block the seed, counter conception and make the spell ineffective. If an attempt to conceive a child is not made within one month of casting, the spell’s effects are lost.

While this is a personal-effect spell, many hedge witches brew potions of conception for others.
